descriptors.name: is_integer
descriptors.description: Returns true when the value is a number with no fractional part; text is never an integer.

descriptors.name: is_negative
descriptors.description: Returns true when the number is less than zero; null is false.

descriptors.description: Returns true when the value is null.

descriptors.description: Returns true when the value is a number; numeric text such as `"4"` is not.

descriptors.name: is_object

descriptors.description: Returns true when the value is text.

descriptors.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

descriptors.name: max
descriptors.description: Returns the larger of two numbers.

descriptors.name: min
descriptors.description: Returns the smaller of two numbers.

descriptors.name: round
descriptors.description: Rounds a number or numeric text to the nearest whole number, halfway values away from zero. When `x` is not a number or numeric text, a supplied `fallback` is rounded and returned instead; without one the call is a type error.

descriptors.name: contains
descriptors.description: Returns true when the needle occurs in the haystack. Text is searched for a case-sensitive substring; array elements and object values (never keys) are compared by their rendered text, so `4` matches `"4"`. A null needle renders as empty text, and a null haystack is false.

descriptors.name: filter
descriptors.description: Retains original items whose callback result is truthy, preserving order.

descriptors.name: first
descriptors.description: Returns the first element of a list, or null when the list is empty or null.

descriptors.name: has_key
descriptors.description: Returns true when the object has the given key; a null object or key is false.

descriptors.name: keys
descriptors.description: Returns the keys of a map in the order they were written; a null map has no keys. Its counterpart is `values`.

descriptors.name: last
descriptors.description: Returns the last element of a list, or null when the list is empty or null.

descriptors.name: length
descriptors.description: Counts the characters of text, the elements of an array, or the keys of an object; a number counts the characters of its displayed text. A boolean is a type error.

descriptors.name: map
descriptors.description: Maps each collection item to its callback result, preserving order and null results.

descriptors.name: values
descriptors.description: Returns the values of a map in the order their keys were written; a null map has no values. Its counterpart is `keys`.

descriptors.name: ends_with
descriptors.description: Returns true when the text ends with the given suffix (case-sensitive); null is false.

descriptors.name: starts_with

descriptors.description: Returns true when the file exists, locally or as a fetched remote URL. descriptors.description: Returns every file a glob reference matches (`&dir/**/name.md`, `^docs/*.md`) as absolute paths, merged across every root of its prefix: the most local root first, then the shallowest, then by path component. A matched file symlink whose target leaves the file tree is skipped with a `dm.glob.skipped_symlink` warning, and a directory the search cannot read is an error. A null pattern lists nothing.

descriptors.name: find_last_index

descriptors.name: load_data
descriptors.description: Reads a YAML, JSON, JSON Lines, CSV, TSV, TOML, or JSON5 file and returns its data converted to the container type `as` describes, or fails naming where the data breaks that type. CSV and TSV rows become objects keyed by the header, or lists of cells, as `as`'s element type says. The optional `options` object chooses how the file is read: `format` (`yaml`, `json`, `jsonl`, `csv`, `tsv`, `toml`, `json5`, or the aliases `yml` and `ndjson`) overrides the extension; `delimiter`, one ASCII character other than a double quote, CR, or LF, separates CSV cells (default a comma; TSV accepts only a tab); `header: false` reads every CSV or TSV record as a row by position, which needs a list-row contract (default `true`). `delimiter` or `header` on a non-tabular format is an error. Null passes through without reading anything.

descriptors.name: set
descriptors.description: Sets a top-level key in the in-memory state map; no disk write. Returns the prior value, or null. An empty or dotted key is an error.

descriptors.name: append_frontmatter
descriptors.description: Appends a value to a frontmatter array property; missing or null starts a new array. Returns the new array. A non-array property is an error.

descriptors.name: decrement_frontmatter
descriptors.description: Decrements an integer frontmatter property (integer text is read as its number); missing or null becomes -1. Returns the new number. Any other stored value is an error.

descriptors.name: delete_frontmatter
descriptors.description: Removes a frontmatter property. Returns the removed value, or null.

descriptors.name: increment_frontmatter
descriptors.description: Increments an integer frontmatter property (integer text is read as its number); missing or null becomes 1. Returns the new number. Any other stored value is an error.

descriptors.name: merge_frontmatter
descriptors.description: Shallow-merges an object into the document's frontmatter. Returns the merged frontmatter.

descriptors.name: prepend_frontmatter
descriptors.description: Prepends a value to a frontmatter array property; missing or null starts a new array. Returns the new array. A non-array property is an error.

descriptors.name: set_frontmatter
descriptors.description: Sets a frontmatter property to the value as given. Returns the prior value, or null.

descriptors.name: append_jsonl
descriptors.description: Serializes any value as one line of JSON and appends it to a file. Returns the absolute path.

descriptors.name: append_line
descriptors.description: Appends text and a newline to a file. Returns the absolute path.

descriptors.name: ensure_dir
descriptors.description: Creates a directory and all parents if missing. Returns the absolute path.

descriptors.name: ensure_file
descriptors.description: Creates an empty file if missing. Returns the absolute path.

descriptors.name: ensure_file
descriptors.description: Creates a file with content if missing; an existing file is unchanged. Returns the absolute path.

descriptors.name: http_post
descriptors.description: Sends an HTTP POST request to an allow-listed host. Returns the response status and body.
